title: Seeker Strike
description:
Deal 9 damage.
Choose 1 of 3 cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
upgraded_description:
Deal 12 damage.
Choose 1 of 3 cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
notes: The card is tagged with Strike. During play, it deals damage to a target enemy, then shuffles the player's draw pile and presents 3 random cards for the player to select 1 from, which is added to the player's hand.
